summary: 1606 Corp., a Nevada prepackaged-software registrant, disclosed that on September 28, 2026 it and Sim Agro Inc. signed a Termination and Mutual Release Agreement ending their May 2, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Stock Exchange and abandoning the proposed acquisition. No shares were issued and no consideration was paid; pre-closing documents were rescinded and mutual releases exchanged, with no termination fee payable by 1606. Certain ENMAS EPC Power Projects creditor rights survive, and Sim Agro remains solely responsible for ENMAS liabilities, indemnifying 1606, including the $422,322 promissory note. Watch for residual ENMAS claims and any new acquisition strategy.
